content.study:
Section 43G — Removal of Member

Section 43G provides the statutory framework for removal of a Member of the Arbitration Council of India, subject to the grounds and procedure specified by the Act.

The provision belongs to the Arbitration Council of India framework. Its operative use depends on the current text, commencement status and regulations made under the Act.
